verdict.rationale: Vercel's deployment pipeline provides git-based versioning, preview environments for review/comments, and one-click rollback plus incremental rollout, which maps onto 'version, review, roll back' for code-based automations tied to deployments. However, this is framed around code deployments rather than AI agent-specific automations/workflows, and there's no evidence of versioning or rollback for agent-created tools or automated workflows themselves. Missing for 10: explicit versioning/rollback UI for AI-agent-authored automations (not just deploys), audit trail for agent actions, and independent corroboration of rollback reliability in AI-native contexts.
